title: Associated primes of a fractional principal intersection quotient in a normal domain
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian normal integral domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with fraction field $K$, and let $0\ne y\in K$. Put $J=A\cap yA=\{a\in A:a=yb\text{ for some }b\in A\}$. An associated prime of $A/J$ is a prime equal to the annihilator of a nonzero class in $A/J$. Then $A/J$ has no embedded associated primes: every associated prime $\mathfrak p$ is minimal among primes containing $J$, and each such $\mathfrak p$ has height one (there is a chain $(0)\subsetneq\mathfrak p$ and no longer chain ending at $\mathfrak p$) [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
